arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Levy argued that RICO injury occurs at the plaintiff's domicile.
Mr. Kennedy argued that RICO injury occurs where the property is located.
Justice Thomas questioned whether all property injuries accrue at the domicile.
Justice Jackson asked about the relevance of the Chattanooga case.

paragraphs: This dispute defines the geographic reach of federal civil RICO jurisdiction. It determines which state courts hear these specific economic claims. It shapes the balance between domestic and foreign property interests.
